title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Publication Plan Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, diff hygiene, and full local Release solution test for RFC 9461 publication planning.
scope: This verification covers deterministic SVCB publication rendering, equivalent HTTPS rendering when guidance and HTTP ALPN warrant it, fast-resolution AliasMode avoidance surfacing, SvcParam preservation for `alpn`, `port`, `dohpath`, and HTTPS SvcParams, invalid TargetName rejection, invalid TTL rejection, and omission of equivalent HTTPS records for non-HTTP bindings.
preconditions: The RFC 9461 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9461.json`.
Scalar DNS service binding values are created by `DnsServiceBindingRecord` before publication planning.
procedure: Run `dotnet test Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` before final goal completion.
expected_result: The focused requirement-home tests pass, the DNS project builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9461 artifacts, generated triage reports the new requirement as trace-clean, diff hygiene passes, and the full local Release solution test suite remains green before final goal completion.
status_summary: The RFC 9461 deterministic publication planner is trace-owned and verified. Live DNS provider publication, DNSSEC, IKEv2 exchange integration, host resolver installation, platform advertisement adapters, and encrypted DNS session establishment remain future work.
